description: Fixed English deny sentences of the PreToolUse policy (05-runner.md section 5.3; rule = step number there) and the UserPromptSubmit block reason (03-api.md section 8.2). The guest uses exactly these texts; tool_forbidden inserts the tool name when it matches name_pattern, else tool_forbidden_unnamed is used.

pre_tool_use.text: Your question was passed to the person through agent.dfx.swiss. End your turn now; the answer arrives as your next prompt.
pre_tool_use.when: rule 1a: AskUserQuestion of a main session; the guest requested the operation human.question for the session (KOR-39, ADR-064 section 3)

pre_tool_use.template: Tool {name} is forbidden in agent.dfx.swiss sessions. Request actions through the platform tools (mcp__platform__request_operation).
pre_tool_use.when: tool not in Read, Glob, Grep, Edit, Write and not a platform tool; {name} = tool name

pre_tool_use.text: This tool is forbidden in agent.dfx.swiss sessions. Request actions through the platform tools (mcp__platform__request_operation).
pre_tool_use.when: as tool_forbidden, for a tool name that does not match name_pattern (never echoed)

pre_tool_use.text: Glob and Grep patterns must stay inside the workspace: no leading / or ~, no .. segment and no NUL character.
pre_tool_use.when: Glob.pattern or Grep.glob starts with / or ~, contains a .. segment or a NUL

pre_tool_use.text: The path could not be resolved inside the session workspace.
pre_tool_use.when: file_path/path is not a string, contains a NUL or cannot be resolved

pre_tool_use.text: The tool call could not be checked and is denied.
pre_tool_use.when: the PreToolUse body does not match mcp/hooks/PreToolUse.request.json (fail closed)

pre_tool_use.text: Write and Edit are allowed only inside the session workspace.
pre_tool_use.when: Write/Edit path resolves outside the workspace

pre_tool_use.text: This path is protected in agent.dfx.swiss sessions and cannot be written.
Read, Glob and Grep are allowed only inside the session workspace and the session harness file.
pre_tool_use.when: Read/Glob/Grep path resolves outside the workspace and is not the own harness file

user_prompt_submit.text: Prompts are accepted only from agent.dfx.swiss.

notice.template: agent.dfx.swiss notice: {n} new item(s) available ({kinds}). Use mcp__platform__get_notifications to see them.
